metadata.title: refactor: rewrite pr-review skill as review-only with design guidance
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary
- Transforms the pr-review skill from a fix-and-report workflow to a **review-only** report — the skill no longer modifies files, it produces findings for the author to address
- Adds structured **design review guidance** covering modularity, OO/polymorphism opportunities, and missing abstractions
- Reorganizes output format into **severity-tiered tables** (Blocking / High / Medium) instead of a single flat table

**Note:** There are unresolved merge conflict markers in the Recommendation section that need to be cleaned up before merge.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The `## Recommendation` section still contains unresolved git merge conflict markers (`<<<<<<<`, `|||||||`, `=======`, `>>>>>>>`). This will render the skill instructions ambiguous/broken; please resolve the conflict and keep a single, consistent recommendation template (one set of options + justification).
```suggestion
[Pick exactly ONE: "Ready to merge" | "Ready after fixing remaining issues" | "Needs significant rework"]
[1 sentence justification]
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The second `bob` command is written as an inline-code span that wraps across a newline. Markdown inline code spans can't contain line breaks (CommonMark), so this may render incorrectly and/or be hard to copy-paste. Consider putting the command on one line, or switch to a fenced code block for multi-line commands.
```suggestion
- `git diff origin/main..HEAD | bob "Review this diff for correctness, security, and design quality. Be specific about line-level issues."`
```

reviews.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
reviews.body: ## Pull request overview Updates the `.claude` “pr-review” skill to be review-only (no file modifications), adds explicit design/OO guidance for reviewers, and restructures the review report into severity-tiered tables. **Changes:** - Converts the workflow from “fix-and-report” to **report-only** with explicit “do not modify files” rules. - Adds **design review guidance** (modularity, polymorphism opportunities, missing abstractions). - Changes the output format to **Blocking / High / Medium** findings tables and updates recommendation wording. --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews. Learn how to get started.
